verdict_reason: Query and payload handshakes now need a listed fulfilment id but session handshakes do not, which can end in a TypeError on save; the sibling refusals stay unlogged and the spec does not describe the new refusal.

todos.issue: The handshake is valid under two rules: query and payload handshakes must resolve a party role (roleOfParty, line 41), but a session handshake is kept when only its journey type is known (isKnownJourneyType, line 85). A session handshake stored before this deploy with a gbn-ag journey type and a fulfilment id the map does not list passes line 85, and a POST to the add page then reaches rolesOfParty (add.controller.js:352), where keepRolesOfferedBy(undefined, ...) reads ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE[undefined].filter and throws a TypeError, a 500 instead of the refusal the query path gives
todos.fix: Must: one function decides whether a handshake context is valid, and the query, payload and session paths all call it, so a session handshake with an unlisted fulfilment id is cleared like one with an unknown journey type. One way: validatedSessionContext tests roleOfParty(fromSession) instead of isKnownJourneyType, and isKnownJourneyType is deleted if nothing else needs it

todos.issue: The new logRefusedHandshake (lines 10-15, 42) logs one refusal, but the two refusals beside it stay silent: the incomplete handshake (lines 37-39, Boom.badRequest) and the session handshake cleared and ignored (lines 85-88). Support cannot tell why a trader returning from a notification got a 400 or was dropped into the address book's own add flow
todos.fix: Must: every branch that refuses or discards a handshake logs once at warn, with journeyType, notificationId and fulfilmentId. One way: call a logging helper before the Boom.badRequest and before storeHandshakeContext(request, null) in validatedSessionContext

todos.issue: Line 41 now refuses a handshake whose fulfilment id is not listed for its journey type with a page-not-found, a new refusal; the behaviour spec's REQ-INS-ADDR-016 (openspec/specs/ins/address-book/spec.md:316-324) still refuses only an unrecognised journey type, so the spec does not say what the code does
todos.fix: Must: the behaviour spec states that a handshake whose fulfilment id is not one the journey lists is refused with page not found, with a scenario linked to a test that proves it. One way: widen REQ-INS-ADDR-016 and add a scenario covered by the new handshake-context tests or an add-page route test
